name: zovo-sql-formatter
displayName: SQL Safe Formatter & Format on Save: PostgreSQL, MySQL, T-SQL, PL/SQL (Zovo)
description: Free and offline SQL formatter that never changes your code: $$ bodies, DELIMITER $$, N'...' strings, [names with spaces] and comments stay exactly as written. Format SQL on save or for a selection in 20 dialects, with procedures indented by block and SQL inside strings.

commands.title: Pick SQL Dialect for This File

enumDescriptions: Pick from the per-file choice, the language mode, the file name (.pgsql, .tsql, .plsql) or the text ($$ bodies, DELIMITER, GO, [names], PACKAGE).
sqlFormatter.dialect.description: SQL dialect for all files. The status bar item picks one for a single file.

sqlFormatter.keywordCase.description: Case of keywords such as SELECT and FROM.

sqlFormatter.dataTypeCase.description: Case of data types such as varchar and int.

sqlFormatter.functionCase.description: Case of function names such as count and coalesce.

sqlFormatter.commaPosition.description: Comma at the end of a line, or at the start of the next one. A comma inside a comment is never moved.

sqlFormatter.maxLineWidth.description: Parenthesized lists shorter than this stay on one line.

enumDescriptions: Clauses on their own lines, contents indented.

sqlFormatter.useEditorIndent.description: Use the editor's tab size and tabs or spaces. Turn off to use the two settings below.

sqlFormatter.tabWidth.description: Spaces per indent when Use Editor Indent is off.

sqlFormatter.useTabs.description: Indent with tabs when Use Editor Indent is off.

sqlFormatter.logicalOperatorNewline.description: Put AND and OR at the start or at the end of a line.

sqlFormatter.denseOperators.description: No spaces around operators: a+b instead of a + b.

sqlFormatter.newlineBeforeSemicolon.description: Put the semicolon of each statement on its own line.

sqlFormatter.procedureLayout.description: Indent stored procedures, functions, triggers and packages by block: BEGIN/END, IF/ELSE, loops, DECLARE and EXCEPTION.

sqlFormatter.maxFileSizeMB.description: Largest file to format as a whole. Larger files: select a part and use Format Selection.

sqlFormatter.timeLimitSeconds.description: Stop formatting after this many seconds and leave the file unchanged.

sqlFormatter.threads.description: Threads for large files (256 KB and up). 0 picks up to 4.

sqlFormatter.showStatusBar.description: Show the SQL dialect in the status bar for SQL files.

sqlFormatter.askForRating.description: Ask for a Marketplace rating after 2 files formatted without an error, in sessions at least 4 hours apart. "Later" asks one more time after 7 days, "No thanks" never asks again. It never asks after an error or more than 2 times. Nothing is sent anywhere.

sqlFormatter.showSupportLinks.description: Show the Rate, More free viewers and Sponsor links in the dialect tooltip. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with SQL Safe Formatter
walkthroughs.description: Format SQL in 20 dialects without breaking $$ bodies, DELIMITER blocks, N'' strings or comments.

steps.title: Format a SQL file
steps.description:
Open a .sql file and press Shift+Alt+F (Shift+Option+F on a Mac), or right-click and choose Format Document.
[Open a sample SQL file](command:sqlFormatter.openSample)

media.altText: A PostgreSQL function and a MySQL procedure formatted, with the $$ body and DELIMITER lines unchanged.

steps.title: Pick the dialect
steps.description:
The status bar shows the dialect, for example PostgreSQL. It is detected from the language mode, the file name and the text. Click it to pick another one for this file.
[Pick a dialect](command:sqlFormatter.pickDialect)

steps.title: Format on save
steps.description:
Turn on Format On Save for SQL files. If the SQL cannot be read, the file is saved as it is and a message shows the line.
[Open the setting](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22editor.formatOnSave%22%5D)

steps.title: SQL inside strings
steps.description: In Python, JavaScript, Java, C# or Go, select the SQL inside a string (or put the cursor in it) and run Format SQL in String from the right-click menu.

steps.title: Keyword case, commas and width
steps.description:
Keyword case, comma first or last, line width, indent style and empty lines between statements.
[Open the settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22sqlFormatter%22%5D)
